blind.description: A stylized cut-stone post-and-lintel doorway or portal archway consisting of two vertical stone pillars and a heavy horizontal lintel block. The geometry is solid, thick, and fully continuous with stylized chiseled stone facets and carved cracks. It stands directly on its own two pillar bases, which sit flat on the floor without an added plinth. The material is stylized hand-painted stone in warm yellowish-brown/ochre tones with dark brown crevice accents and olive-green moss gradients at the base. There are no hovering parts, no unpainted black spots, and no glow or flame effects.
blind.from_above: A single thick rectangular stone block with rounded corners and a small notch/crack along one long side, oriented horizontally.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 7.5 to 8 ft tall), and about 4.5 to 5 ft wide.

notes: Post-and-lintel style facets rather than raw cavern rock face, but reads clearly as an open stone portal at table distance
